name: CopperHead
description: The Bondtech CopperHead is a precision all-metal hotend featuring a bi-metallic heatbreak and a copper alloy heat block for superior thermal performance. Bondtech, primarily known for their extruder systems, designed the CopperHead to complement their BMG and LGX extruders in high-performance direct-drive setups. The V6 threaded nozzle interface ensures wide compatibility, and the copper heat block provides faster and more even temperature distribution than standard aluminium blocks.
features: Copper alloy heat block for superior thermal conductivity
Bi-metallic heatbreak for improved thermal gradient
Designed to pair with Bondtech BMG and LGX extruders
